summary: Auth compatibility with installs of the earlier library entry, READ-ONLY and GLOBAL-ONLY (Greptile PR #2450 round 2 P1; orchestrator decision after Codex novel1219-r10, final narrowing: no writer changes; set-token and logout stay exactly as generated). Env: CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_API_KEY (a set name decides, blank = cleared, unresolved MCP placeholders do not count; legacy names print one deprecation line); logout names the env var config.EffectiveAuthEnv resolves. Saved bearer_auth / api_key are honoured only in the files the generated logout clears: the global credentials file (cliutil decodeCredentialsDocument with allowLegacy for the global file only) and the config document (applyLegacyConfigKey inside parseConfigData; every save marshals only current fields). They count only when the document holds no current credential of any kind (crm_bearer_auth present even empty = cleared), and the token is used only when no current credential of any kind exists anywhere (deferLegacyConfigToken / resolveLegacyTokens), held in an unexported field AuthHeader consults last, so no save writes it back and the generated set-token's saved token outranks it. Earlier keys in a PROFILE credentials file are not honoured; the loader prints one notice naming the file and 'conduyt-crm-pp-cli auth set-token'. No file is written or deleted by this change. cliutil/credentials.go is generator-owned: re-apply this patch on a reprint. Round 12 (Codex novel1219-r11): one sticky rule: the first trusted source in the resolution that declares crm_bearer_auth (present even empty: the config document once accepted as trusted, a loaded credentials file via Credentials.CurrentKeyDeclared) or a set CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH (even blank) sets legacyDisabled, checked before every earlier-key use (held global token, resolveLegacyTokens, the legacy env names); HasValues counts a declared current key, so an explicit profile with crm_bearer_auth = "" does not fall through to the global file. Round 13: the rule lives in one place (legacyAllowed): earlier keys and earlier env names are considered only when no trusted source declared a current credential of any kind; the config document's declaration check runs before any early return, so a document with access_token, auth_header or a non-empty crm_bearer_auth also disables CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH / CONDUYT_API_KEY.
reason: The 4.34.2 reprint reads only CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and crm_bearer_auth; existing installs that use the earlier env names or saved keys would lose authentication on upgrade.
validated_outcome: TestLegacyAuthEnvPrecedence (incl. blank names), TestLegacyAuthRanksBelowEveryCurrentKind (every current kind in the global file and in the config document outranks the earlier key; with nothing current the global earlier key is used, with a notice), TestLegacyAuthConfigDocumentKey (alone, below a global current credential, cleared current key, untrusted document), TestLegacyAuthProfileFileKeysIgnoredWithNotice, TestLegacyAuthGeneratedSetTokenWins (global and config), TestLegacyAuthGeneratedLogoutClears, TestLegacyAuthUnsafeOrAliasedGlobalFileIsNotUsed, TestLegacyAuthSavesNeverWriteLegacyKeys, TestLegacyAuthAddsNoFileWriteOrDelete and TestAuthLogoutReportsLegacyEnvNames pass with no secret in any output; the FULL live gate passes with CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and with only CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH. Round 12: TestLegacyAuthDeclaredCurrentKeyDisablesEveryLegacySource (config empty key + global legacy, profile empty key + global legacy, blank env + global/config legacy, declared key + legacy env name, untrusted declaration not counted, absent everywhere still uses legacy). Round 13: TestLegacyAuthCurrentCredentialInDocumentDisablesLegacyEnv (config access_token / crm_bearer_auth / auth_header + a legacy env name: the current credential is used; config crm_bearer_auth empty + CONDUYT_API_KEY: no credential; global access_token + legacy env: current used; nothing current anywhere: legacy env used).
